description: Instructions for content formatting commands that modify text properties

Bold.off: Remove bold formatting from the word 'Target'.

Italic.off: Remove italic formatting from the word 'Target'.

Underline.off: Remove the underline from the word 'Target'.

Strikethrough.on: Apply strikethrough formatting to the word 'Target'.
Strikethrough.off: Remove strikethrough formatting from the word 'Target'.

Subscript.off: Remove subscript formatting from the word 'Target'.

Superscript.off: Remove superscript formatting from the word 'Target'.

CharacterBorder.on: Add a single solid line border (Auto color, 0.5 pt line width) around the word 'Target'.
CharacterBorder.off: Remove the border from the word 'Target' (set to no border).

CharacterShading.on: Apply 15% pattern shading (Auto Foreground, White Background) to the word 'Target'.
CharacterShading.off: Remove shading from the word 'Target' (set pattern to clear).

DoubleStrikethrough.on: Apply double strikethrough formatting to the word 'Target'.
DoubleStrikethrough.off: Remove double strikethrough formatting from the word 'Target'.

FontSizeIncreaseWord.apply: Increase the font size of the word 'Target' from 12pt to 14pt.

FontSizeDecreaseWord.apply: Decrease the font size of the word 'Target' from 12pt to 11pt.

IndentIncreaseWord.apply: Increase the left indentation of the paragraph containing 'Target' to 1.27 cm.

IndentDecreaseWord.apply: Decrease the left indentation of the paragraph containing 'Target' from 1.27 cm to 0 cm (no indent).

ClearFormatting.apply: Clear all character formatting (bold, italic, underline) from the word 'Target'.

AlignLeft.on: Align the paragraph containing 'Target' to the left.
AlignLeft.off: Change the paragraph containing 'Target' from its current alignment to left alignment.

AlignCenter.off: Change the paragraph containing 'Target' from centered to left alignment.

AlignRight.on: Align the paragraph containing 'Target' to the right.
AlignRight.off: Change the paragraph containing 'Target' from right to left alignment.

AlignJustify.on: Justify the paragraph containing 'Target' (both left and right edges aligned).
AlignJustify.off: Change the paragraph containing 'Target' from justified to left alignment.

TextDirectionLeftToRight.apply: Set the text direction of 'Target' to left-to-right.

TextDirectionRightToLeft.apply: Set the text direction of 'Target' to right-to-left.
